raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of names, and the existing silver_customers step passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map, which the 2026-01-15 CRM note identifies as the code list, maps these codes to WEST, EAST, NORTH and SOUTH, so silver_customers should join to it and fall back to the original value only for unmapped codes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
